description: Defines the implementation of a PDxCH baseband processor class, including its configuration, constructor, and key methods for processing slots, handling requests, and managing modulation completion. It manages modulators, buffers, and frequency control for downlink physical channels in a radio system.

classes.name: pdxch_processor_impl
classes.description: Implements a downlink physical channel baseband processor, managing modulation, buffers, and frequency control, and handling slot processing and request handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a notifier to the processor to receive event notifications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the processor to stop accepting new tasks and waits for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.name: get_request_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the request handler interface.

methods.name: get_baseband
methods.description: Returns a reference to the baseband processor interface.

methods.name: get_center_freq_control
methods.description: Returns a reference to the frequency control interface.

methods.name: process_slot
methods.description: Processes a slot in the downlink physical channel, returning the result.

methods.name: handle_request
methods.description: Handles resource grid requests for downlink transmission.

methods.name: set_carrier_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the carrier center frequency in Hz.

methods.name: on_modulation_completion
methods.description: Callback invoked upon modulation completion for a slot.
